mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.room, c.begin_date, c.end_date, c.master_id, c.subject, c.create_time, c.update_time, e.name AS masterName, ( CASE WHEN now() < c.begin_date THEN 'Not Started' WHEN now() > c.end_date THEN 'Completed' ELSE 'In Progress' END ) AS status FROM clazz AS c LEFT JOIN emp AS e ON c.master_id = e.id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.room, c.begin_date, c.end_date, c.master_id, c.subject, c.create_time, c.update_time, e.name AS masterName, ( CASE WHEN now() < c.begin_date THEN 'Not Started' WHEN now() > c.end_date THEN 'Completed' ELSE 'In Progress' END ) AS status FROM clazz AS c LEFT JOIN emp AS e ON c.master_id = e.id ORDER BY c.begin_date DESC, c.end_date DESC, CONVERT( c.name USING gbk ) ASC, c.id ASC
